label: FREE GUIDE
headline: Decode marketing terms: A plain English guide
body: Download our FREE guide: 102 essential internet marketing terms, explained in plain English from A to Z, to help you understand the online world.
caption: Ever feel like marketing conversations are happening in a secret language? All those acronyms and industry terms can be confusing, especially when you're busy running your own show. That's why we created 'The Internet Marketing Dictionary'. It's a free guide with 102 common marketing terms, explained in plain English from A to Z. No more guessing, just clear answers to help you feel more confident
